name: WASMstein 3D
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: A port of Wolfenduino 3D FX: a Wolfenstein-style first-person shooter whose maps are randomly generated on every playthrough.

descriptions.en: A port of Wolfenduino 3D FX: a Wolfenstein-style first-person shooter whose maps are randomly generated on every playthrough.
descriptions.it: Porting di Wolfenduino 3D FX: uno sparatutto in prima persona in stile Wolfenstein con mappe generate a caso a ogni partita.
